It's in admin tools. IPSIS Administration.

  ![image](data:image/jpeg;base64,)  

Click Ellucian ILP.

Click Configuration

Uncheck Instructors can export grades directly to the SIS

Click Save Configuration

Then when we are ready to re-enable it, we just check the Instructors can export grades directly  to the SIS box. (I'm quite certain it will just remember the ILP Server address, username and password.

To verify that it's been disabled, go to a course in D2L.

Click Assessments

Click Grades

The Submit Grades to registrar button will be gone
